# Veryfi OCR

Veryfi extracts structured data from receipts, invoices, bank statements, tax forms, checks, business cards, and other documents.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/veryfi/.

## Actions

- **Delete Document**: Permanently delete one Veryfi receipt or invoice by document id.
- **Get Document** (read-only): Retrieve one processed receipt or invoice and all extracted OCR fields by its Veryfi document ID.
- **Process Document**: Submit one receipt or invoice to Veryfi OCR by public URL or base64 content.
- **Search Documents** (read-only): List or search processed receipts and invoices using text, identifiers, tags, status, or date ranges, returning one controllable page.
- **Update Document**: Correct practical metadata and review flags on a processed receipt or invoice.
